basic_info.description: Breathtaking views and turnkey sophisticated style define this classic Doelger home at 311 Skyline Drive. The desirable floor plan is refreshed with style, featuring newly refinished parquet hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, and fresh paint inside and out. The spacious living room, complete with a cozy fireplace and picturesque windows, frames an iconic Bay Area panorama: the Pacific Ocean, the Golden Gate Bridge, and the Sutro Tower. The adjacent dining room flows into the all-new kitchen, a showcase of modern style with sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and brand new checker cabinets. The main level hosts two bright bedrooms and an updated bathroom. Below, an ensuite third bedroom and a versatile family room open directly via a large sliding glass door to the easy-maintenance backyard. 2-car tandem garage plus a driveway parking. Nestled in the peaceful Westlake neighborhood, this location is closed to Skyline Plaza, Westlake Shopping Center, Serramonte Center, BART, coastal trails and effortless connection to San Francisco. This quiet enclave combines suburban tranquility with exceptional convenience.
